title: Upper Bounds for the I-MSE and max-MSE of Kernel Density Estimators
summary: The performance of kernel density estimators is usually studied via Taylor expansions and asymptotic approximation arguments, in which the bandwidth parameter tends to zero with increasing sample size. In contrast, this paper focusses directly on the finite-sample situation. Informative upper bounds are derived both for the integrated and the maximal mean squared error function. Results are reached for the traditional case, where the kernel is a probability density function, under various sets of assumptions on the underlying density to be estimated.
